review.conclusion: For a nonempty whole-target literal, N+142*ceil(N/MAX_CHUNK)+32 exceeds Raw N+133*ceil(N/MAX_CHUNK). Current MAX_CHUNK=61440 fits the frame bound. Skipping only this exact positive-length singleton cannot remove a recipe that passes the unchanged strict Raw filter, alter a surviving winner/tie, or suppress another candidate. Empty, mixed Copy/Literal, bounds and decoder paths remain unchanged.

memchr positions are increasing and in-bounds; adding one retains LF in each slice. The optional nonempty unterminated tail avoids phantom records after terminal LF and yields zero records for empty input. MAX_RECORDS+1 preflight and second encode traversal retain the former split_inclusive sequence, matching-work budget and literal fallback. No new unsafe code, allocation or parser authority is introduced.

Verified the four baseline pins against 56e15db Git blobs. Common harness validates role-specific embedded source hashes, executable digests, canonical regenerated plans and fixed six sessions per store. Each store has 60 targets, 6 base seeds and 4 actual schema publications: 70 operations; ten local stores give 700, six WAN stores give 420. Whole uses the unchanged candidate encoder.

New exact-size held-out structured/drift fixtures remain separate from fitting. Eleven object identities must differ. Both selector arms fit once and publish the actual frozen artifact before target 6; acknowledged WarmSession state supplies subsequent bases/readiness. Localized random targets 1 and 3 require SparseV1 and the complete 600-byte exchange.

Setup includes HTTP/context creation, fitting and its training generation. Actual base and artifact publications are paid separately; setup-and-updates includes artifact sender time and paid totals add its receiver time/body exactly once. Target generation is separate and included in the outer interval. Exchange is nested, not pure wire time. Winning-frame capture remains inside selector operation timing equally for before/after; JSON serialization and frame hashing occur after the outer timer. These are process CPU/owned-capacity measurements, not energy or RSS.

Validation requires registered order, exact mode/body/selection/normalized-frame parity, stopped-store regenerated byte equality, matching plan/source/executable identities, receiver observations, and recomputed cumulative totals. Missing/failed operations stop the run and retain failure/store evidence. Local gates use all ten paired ratios at both sizes: replacement <=0.95, localized sum <=1.05, setup/publication/ten-update sender total <=1.05. Failed gates remain results and do not authorize WAN advancement.

Exact branch/source/first-attempt gates, six allowlisted HTTPS tunnel origins, bounded dose/storage and job timeouts, pinned actions, read-only repository permissions, nonpersistent checkout credentials, and a send-step-only capability are present. Baseline overlays exactly four pinned files with EXIT restoration, then source/binary/identity parity checks precede transfer. Runs are sequential without script retries; always-run artifact sealing/upload retain failures. WAN receiver digest is operator-supplied and still requires independent receiver custody/readback.
